summary: Expand lung tumor necrosis with a sparse ProbNet-derived inflammatory/dead population, or resolve it with atomic dead-to-viable cell turnover; non-nuclear debris remains render-owned.

required_observations: complete local neoplastic nuclei for appearance; complete dead and neoplastic nuclei for resolution
contraindications: necrosis not surrounded by compatible tumor

cell_program.core_policy: appearance removes complete source instances intersecting the changed core and uses ProbNet with the target Necrosis prior to regenerate only inflammatory/dead nuclei; resolution removes every observed complete dead instance and regenerates viable tumor nuclei
cell_program.halo_policy: preserve cells outside changed core except exact whole-instance closure

veto_findings: airspace, mucus or fluid rendered as necrosis

necrosis-appearance-v1: sparse ProbNet inflammatory/dead nuclei follow the Necrosis target population
bounded generation support renders non-nuclear necrotic material and karyorrhectic texture
necrosis-resolution-v1: a viable neoplastic population is restored in the resolved compartment

intact viable neoplastic nuclei retained inside new necrosis
dense uniform intact dead nuclei substituted for heterogeneous necrotic material
necrosis-resolution-v1: airspace, mucus or fluid rendered as necrosis
dead debris retained in resolved tumor

mask_guarantees: appearance uses ProbNet target-population regeneration with classes 2/4
render_only_claims: non-nuclear necrotic debris and eosinophilic material
karyorrhectic texture beyond intact CellViT instances

counterexamples: resolving a cavity without viable tumor adjacency
